name: memory-vault
summary: Durable memory in an Obsidian-compatible vault (default ~/.pi/vault): memory_save/search/forget tools, /remember and /memory, automatic per-turn recaps by a configurable cheap model (Projects/<project>/Recaps), promotion of flagged decisions/preferences/gotchas to deduplicated notes, and relevance-gated recall injected as a hidden message (never the system prompt). Replaces memory-local and imports its store once.

models: the session model, or PI_KIT_RECAP_MODEL (provider/id), for recaps
